priors.roi: LogNormal(log 1.0, 0.9) per channel (Meridian-style ROI prior: 90% interval ~0.23-4.4x)
priors.decay: Beta(2, 2.5) per channel (mean 0.44; anything from no carry-over to long carry-over)
priors.half_sat: LogNormal(log 0.9, 0.5) x channel mean spend (half saturation near the operating point)
priors.slope: LogNormal(log 1.2, 0.25) (Hill shape: concave to mildly S-shaped)
priors.baseline: intercept N(log mean y, 0.5); trend N(0, 0.2); Fourier N(0, 0.2); holidays N(0, 0.3)

extra.calibration_method: lift-test likelihood: observed incremental sales per $ removed ~ Normal(model-implied value for the same window/leakage/channels, se_model); se_model = hypot(test SE, 10% transport error)
